entries.en: Fixed a 2.1.265 regression affecting LLM-gateway and proxy setups: the undocumented `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY` environment variable, previously ignored unless `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were both set, began forcing Cloud-gateway sign-in on its own in 2.1.265, so configurations that set it alongside an API key, `apiKeyHelper`, or custom auth headers failed every request with "Not signed in to the Cloud gateway". The variable on its own is ignored again; no configuration change is needed
entries.zh: 修复了影响 LLM 网关和代理设置的 2.1.265 回归：未记录的`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY`环境变量之前被忽略，除非同时设置了`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`和`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`，在 2.1.265 中开始强制云网关自行登录，因此将其与 API 密钥、`apiKeyHelper`或自定义一起设置的配置auth 标头因“未登录云网关”而导致每个请求失败。变量本身再次被忽略；无需更改配置
